# Vendor: TMO "Return of Log Spikes v1 x Remastered"

Pristine upstream input for the DS Log Spikes generator.

- Source: TheMeanOne (TMO) "Return of Log Spikes v1 x Remastered" download
  (originally archived at `/srv/7days/spikes.zip`, 2025-11-20).
- `tools/generate_xml.py` reads vanilla configs and emits the AfterHours
  `mod/Config/*` modlets; this folder preserves the original modlet this server
  used as the starting point (block definitions, localization, recipes).

Do not edit — reference only.
